column1: # Kannada irregular verb stems.
# The productive rules in src/kan.rs build three tense stems off the
# citation root. For a -ు root, with base = root minus -ు: the past
# stem is base + -ಇದ- (neuter 3sg base + -ಇತు), the present stem
# base + -ುತ್ತ-, the future stem base + -ುವ-. A root ending in another
# vowel inserts the glide -ಯ- before the present/future markers and
# forms its past on root + -ದ-. What deviates — a suppletive or
# contracted past stem — is stored here.
# Columns: a `-` cell falls through to the rule.
#   lemma  past_stem  past_3sg_neut  prs_stem  fut_stem
# past_3sg_neut is the full neuter 3rd-singular past form, whose ending
# is idiosyncratic; a `-` there means build it from the past stem
# (past_stem + -ಇತు, e.g. ಕೊಟ್ಟ → ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು).
# ಆಗು "become", ಹೋಗು "go": the -ಗು contracts away in the past (ಆದ-,
# ಹೋದ-) and the neuter 3sg is the special ಆಯಿತು / ಹೋಯಿತು.
ಆಗು
ಹೋಗು
# ಕೊಡು "give" and its compound: past stem ಕೊಟ್ಟ- (gemination).
ಕೊಡು
ಎರವಲುಕೊಡು
# ಕೊಲ್ಲು "kill", ಗೆಲ್ಲು "win": the -ಲ್ಲು past reshapes to a nasal /
# geminate stem (ಕೊಂದ-, ಗೆದ್ದ-).
ಕೊಲ್ಲು
ಗೆಲ್ಲು
# ಹೊರಡು "set out": past stem ಹೊರಟ್ಟ- (ಡು → ಟ್ಟ).
ಹೊರಡು
# ಮೀ "bathe": suppletive past stem ಮಿಂದ-; present/future are the
# regular vowel-final glide forms (ಮೀಯುತ್ತ-, ಮೀಯುವ-).
ಮೀ
